task: Leg 13 (S4): the standing control set on new runs -- T + R = 1 on two lossless one-way cases and the symmetric-source 1.000x check on a soft source, every number with a declared plane, span and normalisation

energy_closure.basis: Physics: in a lossless cell whose two exits are both fully monitored and whose transverse faces are periodic, T + R = 1 exactly. The tolerance is a numerical floor, not a physics allowance. Measured on this fixture at 48 PML cells (leg 18, run 20261019T092126Z-260987): the largest closure residual is 1.61e-07 (control-slab, 1.6098e-07), a margin of 6.21x against 1e-06; control-interface gives 1.14e-08, a margin of 87.8x. The residual is a boundary echo, not a property of the scheme: leg 15 measured it falling 13x per doubling of PML cells from 8 to 32 and linear in the reflected field amplitude, the absorber's echo returning through the structure and interfering at the two extraction planes. The floor is therefore fixture-bound: it belongs to this absorber depth and this geometry, and changing either moves it. At the 32 cells every run before leg 18 used, the same fixture gives 7.51e-07, a margin of 1.33x (leg 18, run 20261019T092119Z-260710, reproducing leg 13 bit for bit). A residual above the tolerance still means a monitor no longer captures all of the power; a residual below it does not mean the boundary is transparent.

symmetric_source.basis: Physics: a soft line source in a homogeneous cell with identical PML at both ends is mirror-symmetric about its own E node, so it must send equal power to two mirror monitors. The gate is the plan's registered 1.000x, i.e. agreement to three decimals; the measured deviation and its margin are reported, not only the verdict.

negative.rule: The one-way source of the interface case's empty run must FAIL the same 1.000x gate. If it passes, the symmetric control cannot tell a symmetric source from a one-way one and proves nothing.

wavelength_um.span: 1.2 to 1.8 micrometres, 21 points, uniform in wavelength
wavelength_um.normalisation: none needed: this is the axis, not a measured quantity

R.plane: reflection monitor, normal x, at x = -2 micrometres
R.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor, 6 cells, by the single z cell
R.normalisation: signed reflected flux divided by the empty-domain reference flux through the same monitor, with the incident contribution subtracted

T.plane: transmission monitor, normal x, at x = +2 micrometres
T.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor, 6 cells, by the single z cell
T.normalisation: signed transmitted flux divided by the empty-domain reference flux through the same monitor

energy_residual.span: the union of the two monitor spans above
energy_residual.normalisation: max |R + T - 1| over the sampled band; a closure check, not an efficiency

empty_reflection_floor.plane: scattered monitor, normal x, at x = -3 micrometres
empty_reflection_floor.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor, 6 cells, by the single z cell
empty_reflection_floor.normalisation: max over the band of |empty-run scattered-monitor flux| divided by |empty-run reflection-monitor flux| (the x = -2 micrometre monitor)

sourcepower_reduced.plane: the one-way source line, reconstructed from the discrete E and interpolated Yee H
sourcepower_reduced.normalisation: solver reduced units, cross-checked against the same-monitor empty-domain flux; NOT a physical power in watts

reference_power_reduced.plane: reflection monitor, normal x, at x = -2 micrometres (snapped), in the EMPTY run
reference_power_reduced.span: full periodic transverse width of the monitor, 6 cells, by the single z cell
reference_power_reduced.normalisation: none: |signed empty-run flux| through the reflection monitor, per frequency, solver reduced units; the denominator of R and of the floor, not a power in watts

sourcepower_max_relative_error.plane: the one-way source line against the same-monitor reference flux
sourcepower_max_relative_error.normalisation: max |sourcepower / reference - 1|; a self-consistency check of the incident-power estimate

oneway_ratio_max_deviation.plane: transmission monitor at +2 and scattered monitor at -3 micrometres, one-way source, EMPTY run
oneway_ratio_max_deviation.span: the sampled band, frequencies where both carry at least 1 percent of the peak power; if none, the backward side is below the floor everywhere
oneway_ratio_max_deviation.normalisation: max |forward / backward - 1| for a ONE-WAY source: the negative control, which must fail the 1.000x gate
